text: Because new hedge fund managers concentrate on highly complex and profitable instruments where pricing and valuation problems are most prevalent, it becomes very difficult for managers to guarantee investors standard or accurate pricing procedures.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability

abstract: Most of these new managers focus their attention on highly complex and profitable instruments where pricing and valuation issues are most prevalent. This trend can make it very difficult for hedge fund managers to guarantee their investors standard or accurate pricing procedures.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: for newly launched funds run by managers leaving large institutions
